desktop.notesZh:
批次七（路由预演独立 + 企业规范右侧文档栏批）
① 设置·多模型路由：预演从关键词规则页拆出独立「预演」tab（排关键词后）；输入框改多行 textarea；判定结果改醒目 hero 卡（档位色带 + 角色名大字 + 模型 chip + 命中关键词/派给模型详情行）
② 工作流·企业规范：删卡头长说明文案；删「企业规范资产（方案乙）」与「baf-standard · 工程规范」两卡；文档预览从底部改右侧停靠栏（IDE 打开文件式抽屉，标题 + 打开文件/关闭 + 全文滚动）
③ 工作流·质量监控：按 bafplugin 真实实现重建——baf-quality 工具链资产三分组（环境搭建 / 配置 / 规范文档，共 9 条真文档），点击同样右侧查看器打开全文，门禁机制占位卡退役
④ 修复文档抽屉背景透明透字（页面未定义 --dsw-alias-bg-primary，补 #ffffff 兜底）
desktop.notesEn:
Batch seven (standalone route preview + enterprise right doc pane)
(1) Settings > model routing: the dry-run moves out of the keywords tab into its own Preview tab (after Keywords); the input becomes a multi-line textarea; the verdict renders as a prominent hero card (tier-tinted band + large role name + model chip + matched-keyword / routed-model detail lines)
(2) Workflow > enterprise standards: card-head long description removed; the two redundant cards (plan-B assets, baf-standard engineering rules) removed; the document preview moves from the bottom into a right docked pane (IDE open-file style drawer: title + open-file/close + full-text scroll)
(3) Workflow > quality: rebuilt after the real bafplugin implementation - the baf-quality toolchain assets in three groups (env setup / config / standards docs, 9 real documents), each opening in the same right viewer; the static gate-mechanism placeholder card is retired
(4) Fixed the doc drawer rendering see-through (page never defines --dsw-alias-bg-primary; added a #ffffff fallback)

dsh.notesZh: 上游 DeepSeek Harness 运行时（会话、工具、Web GUI）
dsh.notesEn: Upstream DeepSeek Harness runtime (session, tools, Web GUI)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-core.notesZh: baseline loader、adapter stub、bafCore isolate 挂载；§22.17 J intake-mode-set 分类改判事件；两档/三档 TierMode + coerce；Worker 关键词死规则过滤（escalateOnly 下 low 档永不改变结果且 first-match 遮蔽真实升档；两档模式 mid coerce 同死），low 档预设包 routineEdits 移除
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-core.notesEn: Baseline loader, adapter stubs, bafCore isolate mount; two/three-grade TierMode + coercion; dead Worker-grade keyword rules filtered out (a low keyword never changes the outcome under escalateOnly and first-match shadowed real escalations; mid coerces to low in two-grade mode), low-tier preset pack routineEdits removed

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesZh: projection、intake、transition、工作流 Tab Remote；full-go-path 七阶段 + drift/abandon/T11；Phase 6 bug 快路径与 T15 升级；Phase 7 verify CheckRunner 接入 stack/guard adapter；§22.17 J：分类弹窗两路径改道（intake-mode-set）+ 缺陷草案五字段 + auto-pop 宿主行（状态驱动自动弹）+ 门弹窗通道；卡死修复 A–G：/baf-go 直绑唯一活跃变更、铸造设焦点、已确认未 open 不重弹、Tab 恢复按钮、mode= 硬要求、setIntakeMode 补救臂、git_unavailable 审计；OpenSpec×Matt 融合：会话提示词节 baf:standard-rules 每回合注入工程规则源；effectiveRouteKeywordRules 透传 tierMode（死规则过滤随档位模式生效）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesEn: Projection, intake, transition, workflow tab Remote; full-go-path seven stages + drift/abandon/T11; Phase 6 bug fast path and T15 escalation; Phase 7 verify CheckRunner wires stack/guard adapters; §22.17 J: clickable path re-routing in the classify dialog (intake-mode-set) + five-field bug draft + auto-pop host row (state-driven auto popup) + gate dialog channel; OpenSpec×Matt fusion: the baf:standard-rules session section injects the standards source every turn; effectiveRouteKeywordRules passes tierMode through so dead-rule filtering follows the active grade mode

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesZh: OpenSpec 本地文件适配器：骨架、校验、原子归档；design/tasks 模板 TODO 提示规则源锚点（偏离需注明、测试遵循 testing-discipline）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesEn: Local file-mode OpenSpec adapter: skeleton, validate, atomic archive; design/tasks template TODOs point at the rules source anchors

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesZh: 新增 enterprise-docs 资产目录与 enterpriseDoc RPC：10 份 bafplugin 迁移的真实企业规范文档随包资产发布（skills/sora-c-code-standards 等），浏览器端按 id 拉取全文；批次七增 QUALITY_DOCS 6 条（baf-quality 环境搭建/配置真资产：project.yml、config.json、CPPLINT.cfg、cppcheck-suppressions.xml 等）；摘要投影不变
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesEn: New enterprise-docs asset catalog + enterpriseDoc RPC: ten real bafplugin-migrated enterprise standard documents ship as package assets (skills/sora-c-code-standards etc.) served by id to the browser; batch seven adds QUALITY_DOCS (six real baf-quality env/config assets: project.yml, config.json, CPPLINT.cfg, cppcheck-suppressions.xml, ...); summary projection unchanged

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesZh: C 栈质量执行器：build/test/coverage/analyzer 命令注入；占位态返回 policy_missing 与工具版本
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesEn: C stack quality executor: build/test/coverage/analyzer command injection; placeholder state returns policy_missing and tool versions

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesZh: 工具调用硬门禁：fs/shell 同步裁决 + projection 重读 + 密钥扫描 + 危险/间接 shell 模式识别；install row 注入每个 agent 的 tools.guard；§22.17 J 未决门期间拦截通用提问工具（gate_pending_ask_blocked）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesEn: Tool-call hard gate: synchronous fs/shell adjudication + projection re-read + secret scan + dangerous/indirect shell pattern detection; install row hooks tools.guard for every agent

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesZh: 工作区 init 骨架三产物：基线配置 + 默认工程规则文档（.baf/standards/default-rules.md）+ openspec 目录；人工确认才落盘，差异文件走 .baf-backup-<时间戳> 备份
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesEn: Workspace init skeleton, three artifacts: baseline config + default rules document (.baf/standards/default-rules.md) + openspec layout; requires human confirmation, divergent files moved to .baf-backup-<timestamp>
